[[Category:Killycurragh Townland, Derryloran Parish, County Tyrone]]
== Biography ==
James was born about 1844. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1699|John Glasgow]] and [[Ferguson-16492|Ann Ferguson]].  
<ref name="wm">We can be confident of this, as his son Nelson appears in his father's will.</ref>

On 20 Jul 1869 at Orritor Presbyterian, he married Sarah Henry (minor),of Montober, daughter of Robert Henry, farmer.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/12854d3083801 James Glasgow, Sarah Henry, 20 Jul 1869, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

He passed away 1 Mar 1906 age 61 at Killycurragh. Attended by Robert Glasgow, son.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/da19a33455362 James Glasgow, 1906, Cookstown, 61] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>
<ref>PRONI Will Calendars (with image): "Probate of the Will of James Glasgow (S) late of Killycurragh County Tyrone Farmer who died 1 March 1906 granted at Armagh to Silas Weir Henry and Robart Henry (Junior) Farmers."</ref>
<ref name="wm"/>
A marriage for James Glasgow and Henry was registered on 20 July 1869 in the Cookstown district.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/marriage GRONI civil marriage index], 20 July 1869, Cookstown district, M/1869/L1/1132/1/172.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1699]] is assessed at 99% (proved). John’s held 1905 will explicitly bequeaths to “my son James Glasgow of Killycurr”. James’s Killycurragh family and death shortly before John agree, distinguishing the named son from other local Jameses.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the original will with James’s 1869 marriage father field.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1732 Northern Ireland, Wills and Administrations]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Information from the will:
* Silas Weir Henry of Killycurragh, Robert Henry Jun of Montober
* Wife: Sarah Glasgow
* Son: Robert Glasgow
* Son: John
* Son: Sam (unmarried)
